prompt: A towering knight in soot-black oxidized plate armor, a tattered crimson tabard hanging from his shoulders, stands in a menacing three-quarter pose facing south-west, gripping a heavy longsword point-down into the stone floor. Threads of crimson life-essence are drawn out of the dark air and siphon into the seams of his armor, glowing faint blood-red. His helm is a horned sallet, eye-slit lit dim red. The background is a cold stone crypt lit only by the red glow of the siphoning life-essence.

A dread knight in blackened verdigris-bronze plate armor looms over a kneeling robed summoner who clutches his own chest in pain, a ribbon of crimson blood-light streaming from the summoner upward into the knight. The knight stands rigid and tall, with broad pauldrons, a horned helm, and a greatsword resting on his shoulder. The summoner is small and hunched at the feet of the towering knight. The background is a torchlit dark stone hall.
